setting.label: 1904 CE · Dublin, 16 June
setting.note: The 036200 manuscript identifies 16 June 1904 as the main Dublin day; 036700 and 037100 explicitly discuss the 1904 setting. Memories reach earlier years. This is distinct from 1922 publication.

description: Follows Stephen, Bloom, and Molly through a Dublin day, examining epic correspondences, changing literary forms, kinship, and urban life. Covers The Story, Part One: Stephen’s Morning; Telemachus: a tower that is not home; Nestor: teaching history without escaping it; A whole day, and no grand victory.
